beats.say: Your landlord kept part of your deposit? We built an agent for that.

beats.label: Lease, photos and their list
beats.say: Upload your lease, your move out photos, and the landlord's list of deductions.

beats.label: Checking every charge
beats.say: It checks each charge against your photos, sorts wear and tear from real damage, and checks the deadline for your state.

beats.title: Deposit check
beats.say: You get every deduction marked fair, wear and tear, or no proof.

beats.title: Deposit request
beats.text:
Hi, I moved out on Sept 30 and returned the keys that day.
Your list charges $750 for carpet and paint, which is normal wear and tear, and $75 for a lock change with no receipt.
Please return $825 by Oct 28. Thank you.
beats.say: Then it drafts the letter for the charges you dispute. You review it and send it yourself.
The Deposit Agent is a ten dollar Claude prompt kit. Comment DEPOSIT for the free guide.
